recipe.operation: COPY one full learned encoder column, bias and decoder row from groups 75..1023 into a new sixth concept slot. Donors and all five original slots remain in place. New-coordinate Adam moments start at zero.
recipe.selection: TRAIN-only, largest additive object-contrast residual reduction among reserve directions with nonzero foreground raw activity. Uniform random addition from the same legal category pool; no development/test choice.
recipe.receivers: Initialized concept slots 0..74 in saved category order. Keep original TRAIN-selected capture/detection readouts and heads; log off-slot exceptions rather than silently retarget them.
recipe.padding: Native rectangular 6D storage; reserve sixth slots are exactly-zero, zero-moment padding. They cannot learn under this objective and are checked at every inspected checkpoint. Effective widths are 6 for concept slots, 5 for reserves.
recipe.preservation: No original slot is removed or reassigned. During the 500 updates, existing and added directions may train. Original directions are not numerically frozen.
recipe.controls: Targeted/random have identical usable capacity, gate, root, Adam/head/controller, image/noise streams and update budget. Ordinary AGF/Vanilla are budget controls, not addition-capacity controls.
recipe.gating: Unchanged raw group L2 Top-16, no width normalization; maximum active slots may rise from 80 to 96.
recipe.development: Initial and final reports on selection and confirmation; primary original readouts plus separately labelled initialized-slot diagnostics. No test features or intervals.
recipe.endpoint: Final 500 updates; retain all outcomes. No automatic adoption or search based on development.
